activity.notes: Long Yun was the dominant Yunnan warlord and provincial governor from the late 1920s until Chiang Kai-shek removed him in the 1945 Kunming coup. ATLAS uses Yunnan Clique rather than generic Republic of China provincial administration because his regime possessed substantial autonomous military and political power.

sources.title: S. C. M. Paine, The Wars for Asia, 1911–1949 — China 1926–1936
sources.citation_text: Cambridge describes Long Yun as the long-ruling regional warlord of Yunnan and distinguishes his regional home-rule power from national contenders.

sources.title: Long Yun — office chronology
sources.citation_text: The office chronology gives Long Yun's governorship as 17 January 1928 to 2 October 1945.
